title: Proper forget supports and the specified compact-support compositor
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p:W→X, f:X→S and h:W→S proper maps with w:p;f=h, and E any object of D(W_et,A). Write c_a:Ra!≅Ra* for the canonical proper comparison [def-sp-unbounded-proper-shriek-star-comparison], α! for the specifically constructed properRouteCompIso(A,p,f,h,w), and α* for the ordinary rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp. Then α!⁻¹(E);c_h(E) = Rf!(c_p(E));c_f(Rp*E);α*(E). This compares only direct-image composition, without tensor, projection formula, or a cartesian square.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction before a trace; the coordinate triangle computation before applying its scalar trace

proof.text: Substitute h=p;f and expand the specific rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso into its comparison of compactifications, the compactification-composition isomorphism, and the final comparison. Commute the latter comparison with forget supports using the proved rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso_hom_app_comp_toLowerStar.

Expand the compactification-composition isomorphism. Its factors are ordinary direct-image composition, open-extension composition and the open/proper exchange. Naturality of the open forget-supports adjunct and the composite counit formula show compatibility for open-extension composition. The proved rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationBaseChangeMap'_app_comp_toLowerStar gives the exchange compatibility. Cancel inverse compactification comparisons. Associativity of ordinary direct-image composition identifies the resulting path with the right side. Properness identifies all forget-supports transformations here with the recorded c_a.

    (p : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) (h : W ⟶ S) (w : p ≫ f = h)

    (properRouteCompIso A p f h w).inv.app E ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).hom.app E =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).hom.app E) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p f h w).hom.app E
